newsitem.title: FRANCE: Guinness boss no longer on LVMH board.
newsitem.headline: Guinness boss no longer on LVMH board.

text.p: Guinness chairman Tony Greener is off the board of luxury goods group LVMH after his mandate was not renewed, the company said on Thursday.
Chairman Bernard Arnault told the shareholders meeting that Greener had written to him a week earlier to say he would not attend the AGM, after which his mandate was due to expire.

Relations between Guinness and LVMH, onetime allies, have soured since Guinness's decision to merge with Grand Metropolitan over the objections of LVMH, Guinness's largest shareholder with 14 percent.

LVMH on Wednesday threatened to throw a spanner into the works by exercising options to buy Guinness's participations in their joint distribution ventures and in Moet Hennessy, 66 percent owned by LVMH and 34 percent by Guinness.
LVMH's board, including new members Albert Frere, Jean-Marie Messier and Charles David Powell, met on Thursday after the AGM.
